newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-SUPERSPORT SERIES CLOSE OF PLAY SCORES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SUPERSPORT SERIES CLOSE OF PLAY SCORES.

text.p: Close of play scores in the
four-day Supersport Series cricket matches on Sunday.
Western Province 509-7 declared. Western Province won by an
Centurion (day three): Free State 349. Northern Transvaal
by an innings and five runs.
East London (day three): Border 261. Eastern Province 338
for five. Match abandoned because of heavy rain.
Kimberley (day three): Transvaal 440 for six declared and
120 for four (A.Bacher 71 not out). Griqualand West 327
